question: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) Scheme was launched by which ministry?

options.text: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PM SVANidhi** is a central government scheme that aims to provide financial assistance to street vendors to resume their livelihoods, which were impacted due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• The scheme was launched on June 1, 2020, by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA).
 
• Under this scheme, street vendors can avail of a working capital loan of up to Rs. 10,000, which is repayable in monthly installments within a year.
 
• The scheme targets to benefit over 50 lakh street vendors across the country.
 
• The scheme also provides incentives to promote digital transactions among street vendors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ministry of Consumer Affairs - This ministry is responsible for regulating and promoting consumer interests in the country. It is not directly related to the PM SVANidhi scheme.
 
• Ministry of Finance - This ministry is responsible for the management of the country's financial resources. While it might have some indirect involvement in the scheme, it is not the primary ministry responsible for its implementation.
 
• Ministry of Commerce - This ministry is responsible for promoting and regulating foreign trade and commerce in the country. It does not have a direct role in the PM SVANidhi scheme.
